carText: Take Jayu-ro and exit at Seongdong IC, then follow the signs straight for about 1.6km (passing Seongdong intersection), turning left at Heyri intersection to arrive about 500m ahead.
Via the Seoul Ring Expressway, follow Jayu-ro toward 'Munsan, Kintex' for about 27km from the Jayu-ro junction to reach Seongdong IC.
Search for 'Gyeonggi Future Education Campus' in your navigation app to find it easily.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about the festival.

items.a: It's free. Everyone is welcome to attend.
For safety reasons, pets are not allowed.

items.q: Will it still happen if it rains?
items.a: Yes, the festival will go on; some programs may move indoors.
On-site parking is limited, so public transit is recommended.

items.q: How do I sign up for experience programs?
items.a: Use the reservation button on the Experience Program page.
